content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user with a personal task list","i_want":"to edit an existing task, changing its title, description, priority, status and Due Date","so_that":"my task details stay accurate and up to date","business_description":"The user opens an existing task in the task form, changes its fields and saves. The backend validates the changes, stores them and updates the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message only after the backend responds. Validation rules are the title must be non-empty and at most 100 characters, and the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date.","business_value":"Users can correct and maintain their tasks without deleting and recreating them, which keeps the task list and report accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority, status and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, priority, status and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns success","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC"}],"edge_cases":["The title is exactly 100 characters: the update is accepted.","The title is 101 characters: the update is rejected and the stored title is unchanged.","The Due Date equals the Creation Date: the update is accepted, because the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date.","The Due Date is one day earlier than the Creation Date: the update is rejected.","An update request is sent for a task deleted by another session: the backend returns Task Not Found and no data is changed.","The backend is unreachable or returns a server or database error: the frontend shows an error and does not show the task as updated.","Open question: the PRD does not say whether a title containing only spaces counts as empty. The team must decide before implementation.","Open question: the PRD does not say whether the Creation Date can be changed by an update. This story assumes it cannot."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} (or the update endpoint agreed in the backend task) accepts title, description, priority, status and Due Date and returns the updated task.","Title validation rejects empty titles and titles longer than 100 characters, with a clear error message.","Due Date validation rejects a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date.","Last Updated Date is set by the backend on every successful update and unchanged on rejected updates.","Task Not Found is returned for an unknown ID.","The edit form is pre-filled with the existing values and reuses the creation form.","The frontend does not show the task as updated or show a success message until the backend returns success.","Success and error messages are shown after each update action.","The test suite covers success, validation, not-found, server error and pending-state paths."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and Last Updated Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Implement the update endpoint for an existing task by ID. Do not apply optimistic updates.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The form is reused for editing and pre-fills all fields with existing values.","Client-side title validation matches the backend rules and shows the title-mandatory and 100-character messages.","While the request is pending the list shows the previous values and no success message is shown.","A success message is shown only after the backend returns success.","On error the task is not shown as updated and an error message is shown."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for editing an existing task","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Test suite covering the edit flow end to end: successful update, title and Due Date validation, not-found and server error paths, the pending state with no optimistic update, and Last Updated Date behaviour.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover successful edit, title empty, title over 100 characters, Due Date before Creation Date, and unknown ID.","Tests confirm the list keeps previous values and no success message appears while the request is pending.","Tests confirm a failed update shows an error and the task is not shown as updated.","Tests confirm Last Updated Date changes on success and is unchanged on rejected updates."]}]}
